Name: Ticket Price Editor
Author: snowkittyselene
Description:
Do you think Pam is overcharging for the bus ride to the desert? What about Willy, asking for 1000g every time you want to ride the boat you helped fix? Or, do you think differently, and want them to charge more? This is the mod for you!

This very simple mod allows you to change the prices for the bus ticket to Calico Desert and the boat ticket to Ginger Island to anything between free and 1,000,000g. Any price changes will take effect starting the next day, if you edit the config (either manually or through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿).


Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ to function. Generic Mod Config Menu isn't required, but is heavily recommended.


I may add the ability to toggle daily randomization of prices within a user-specified range in a future update.
